purpose: Distinguish actionable net-value improvement from economic repricing, common factor movement and evidence/model error.
non_goals: Assumed mean reversion or fixed-calendar rotation

tiers.title: Evidence and comparability
tiers.question: Can these observations be compared at this decision time?
tiers.acceptance: Reject future-known inputs, stale quotes, wrong split/ADR/FX and different return conventions.

tiers.title: Economic relationship graph
tiers.question: Why could one company affect another?
tiers.output: Directed typed edges with exposure, terms, effective dates and evidence
tiers.acceptance: Separate verified contract/ownership from shared-customer exposure or hypothesized pass-through; avoid spend double counting.

tiers.title: Business economics and normalization
tiers.question: What earnings and cash does each business actually retain?
tiers.acceptance: Reconcile reported to recurring earnings, SBC, financing and economic reinvestment; no P/E ranking for negative EPS.

tiers.title: Market relationship and attribution
tiers.question: Which movement is common exposure and which is issuer-specific?
tiers.output: Multiwindow return correlation, beta, downside dependence, factor residual and stability flags
tiers.acceptance: Use synchronized returns not correlated trending price levels; separate sessions; report estimation error and effective sample.

tiers.title: Comparable valuation and relative-value change
tiers.question: Did market price change, economics change, or the valuation convention change?
tiers.output: Common-horizon value ranges, discount ratios, current/frozen baseline index and revision attribution
tiers.acceptance: Separate fixed-endpoint from rolling NTM views; company-specific multiples under common macro assumptions; reconcile revision/FX/horizon effects.

tiers.title: Persistence, regime and event diagnosis
tiers.question: Is divergence temporary, structural, or not identifiable?
tiers.output: Event-aligned residual paths, break flags, competing explanations and falsifiers
tiers.acceptance: No mean-reversion or lead-lag claim without stability and out-of-sample evidence; lagged association is not causation.

tiers.title: Net portfolio decision
tiers.question: Does a feasible action improve the account relative to holding?
tiers.output: Hold/cash/partial/full action frontier, net wealth ranges and two-way price thresholds
tiers.acceptance: Include both legs, cash, distributions, tax timing, financing, concentration and pathwise margin; no action from incomplete required inputs.

tiers.title: Evaluation and controlled maturation
tiers.question: Does the method work beyond the examples used to design it?
tiers.output: Point-in-time walk-forward results, rejected signals, benchmark comparison and acceptance receipt
tiers.acceptance: Include delisted/failed cases, missed fills, costs, multiple-testing control and untouched holdout; synthetic checks do not demonstrate trading advantage.

implementation_refs.role: review and tested candidate patch; adoption unverified

success_metrics: All decisions replay from then-available input revisions
Net risk/wealth and turnover improve against declared benchmark on held-out data, or absence of advantage reported
next_action: Qualify input/cash boundary with B04, then build one common-endpoint revision ledger.
ownership_note: Design-only pointers; owner allocation and independent evidence required before implementation.
